description: Enable and fix all UnifiedOrchestrator functionality including modules, quality gates, monitoring, collaboration, execution plans, and DPO integration

tasks.prompt: CRITICAL BUG: Module loading returns empty dict. Analyze why modules in src/unified/unified_orchestrator.py aren't loading. Check _load_modules() method at line 246, examine imports at lines 273, 298, 319, 343. The module_registry.initialize_all() returns {} but should have quality_gates, monitoring, collaboration modules. Find the root cause - are module files missing? Import errors? Registration failing?

Fix module import issues in UnifiedOrchestrator. The imports at lines 273, 298, 319, 343 are trying to import from src.modules but failing silently. Create the missing module files if they don't exist: src/modules/quality_gates_module.py (QualityGatesModule class), src/modules/monitoring_module.py (MonitoringModule class), src/modules/collaboration_module.py (CollaborationModule class), src/modules/execution_plan_module.py (ExecutionPlanModule class). Each module must inherit from OrchestratorModule and implement required methods.

Implement QualityGatesModule in src/modules/quality_gates_module.py. It needs to: 1) Inherit from OrchestratorModule, 2) Register quality gate validators (database, http, file_exists, code_quality, test_results), 3) Provide validate_task() method to check task outputs, 4) Store results in gate_results dict. Reference the quality gate types in src/execution_plan_schema.py lines 75-87.

Implement MonitoringModule in src/modules/monitoring_module.py. Must track: 1) Agent health status, 2) Task execution metrics, 3) Performance data per agent type, 4) Resource usage. Integrate with enhanced_metrics dict in UnifiedOrchestrator. Provide real-time status updates via get_agent_status() method.

Implement CollaborationModule in src/modules/collaboration_module.py. Enable: 1) Team creation and management (UnifiedOrchestrator.teams dict), 2) Shared workspace for agents, 3) Task handoffs between agents, 4) Workspace synchronization. Use EnhancedAgentTask fields: team_id, assigned_agents, collaboration_mode.

Add from_dict() classmethod to ExecutionPlan class in src/execution_plan_schema.py (around line 308). It must: 1) Take a dict parameter, 2) Convert nested dicts to proper dataclass instances (TaskDefinition, QualityGate, ExecutionPhase, ResourceRequirements), 3) Handle enum conversions (TaskType, ExecutionMode, etc), 4) Return ExecutionPlan instance. This is REQUIRED for --execution-plan flag to work.
